ValidationRule.description: Roadside supervisor should not be able to edit these fields on Dealerships and National accounts. In spite of modify accounts Roadside permission set
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name = "Service User", RecordType.Name <> "TCS Service Accounts", RecordType.Name <> "Independent Service Provider", RecordType.Name <> "Fleet & Repair Shops", RecordType.Name <> "PacLease Account", $UserRole.Name = "Roadside", OR( ISCHANGED(Phone), ISCHANGED(PCC_Use_Phone__c), ISCHANGED(Fleet_Code__c), ISCHANGED(KW_Corresponding_Dealer__c), ISCHANGED(PB_Corresponding_Dealer__c), ISCHANGED(Industry), ISCHANGED(Service_Email__c), ISCHANGED(Centralized_Billing__c) ), (NOW() - CreatedDate > 0.0417) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have Permission to Edit this field on this type of account
